title: Identification of lipid metabolism related immune markers in atherosclerosis through machine learning and experimental analysis.
summary: Machine-learning selection identified six lipid-related atherosclerosis markers, with expression-level experimental confirmation.
ai_technology: Four GEO datasets support WGCNA and multiple learned feature-selection methods; the paper evaluates a diagnostic model and assays selected genes.
organization: Department of Thyroid Breast Vascular Surgery

evidence.tested: The source reports six diagnostic candidates and experimental expression checks; docking is hypothesis-generating, not evidence of therapeutic efficacy.
evidence.unknown: Primary Results describe the specific comparator, cohort or experimental check; limitations are stated narrowly.
